summary: Verified the FB short-text dedup fix. post_hash now returns None for texts with fewer than 80 word chars, and post_status only checks the hash when one exists. The live feed had 7 posts: 2 different 'Obavještavamo vas o smrti' notices (fb-1794145135 and fb-1794127197), 'Velike vijesti iz cazina!', 'Cazin kroz umjetnost...' and 3 junk posts. Cron auto-import brought in 4 articles: both death notices as separate articles (different ids/slugs, fb_post_hash=null, category obavjestenja) plus the 2 real news posts. Junk posts were skipped. GET /api/public/articles?category=obavjestenja returns 2 items and neither is on /api/public/home. Running cron again created no duplicates. After hard-deleting one notice, the posts list showed it as 'new' and the other as 'imported', and the next cron re-imported it. In the UI dialog (desktop 1920 and mobile 390) each post showed the right status ('Nova' / 'Već objavljeno'), the checkbox was disabled for imported posts, and a manual import of the new notice worked (result 'Objavljeno: 1').

issues: The top-right X close button (shadcn DialogClose) has no data-testid; fb-import-close exists only on the 'Zatvori' button in the result view

critical_code_review_comments: post_key uses only createdTime ('fb-{createdTime}'). If a post has no createdTime, every such post gets the key 'fb-None', and short-text posts no longer have a hash fallback, so the 2nd and later ones would be skipped as duplicates. Consider falling back to photoURL/post id.
Two different posts published in the same second would get the same key (unlikely edge case).
Hard-deleting an article (an admin action, if one exists) leaves its facebook media and versions orphaned. This is cleanup hygiene only.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleanup done: hard-deleted all fb_post_key articles plus their facebook media and FB-import article_versions (including 1 orphan version 'Potražnja za poslom' from an earlier run), cleared fb_ignored and the settings key fb_auto. test_fb@ccn.ba was left for the main agent to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cron /api/cron/facebook-import is fire-and-forget (it returns {ok:true} straight away). Poll settings fb_auto.value.last_run to know when it finished. Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported and -n 0. The feed changes over time (it now also contains 'Cazin kroz umjetnost'), so the expected article counts will change.
